detail.goal: Open the book 'The Grand Design' from the Science category and read its price including tax and how many copies are in stock

detail.why: The goal specifies the book is in the Science category; the sidebar category link filters the catalogue to Science titles.

detail.target: link named "The Grand Design" in frame "root" #0
detail.why: Title link for 'The Grand Design' within the Science listing — opens the product detail page which carries the tax-inclusive price and stock count.
The value cell in the same row as the 'Price (incl. tax)' label in the Product Information table — the authoritative tax-inclusive price, rather than the summary price shown beside the title.
The value cell in the same row as the 'Availability' label — states the number of copies in stock, unlike the listing page which only says 'In stock'.

detail.summary: Navigated Home → Science category → 'The Grand Design' product page and read its Product Information table. Price (incl. tax) is £13.76 (tax £0.00, so equal to the excl. tax price) and availability is 'In stock (5 available)'. Both values were recorded via row-label anchors ('Price (incl. tax)' and 'Availability'), so replay can relocate them even if the amounts or counts change. Checkpoint is the stable 'Product Information' heading on the detail page.
